[DAY1 20:31:30 - DAY1 20:31:59]
I put the takeout into the microwave. "I'll throw it in the microwave," I say. I turn off the microwave and head to the living room. "Strong insulation, hmm," I say. I talk with Lucia. Lucia: "Uh, which microwave are you using?" I ask, "How is it strong insulation?" Katrina: "What's up?" Lucia: "Nothing, just our takeout arrived." Katrina comes over and I look at her. We discuss it together. Lucia: "Haha, so we often just leave it in the microwave to keep warm." "Yeah, but this one doesn't," I say. I notice a rice cooker, take a bag, and put it into the rice cooker by the kitchen. Lucia: "Make the most of it, really."

[DAY1 13:40:00 - DAY1 13:40:30]
I place the microwave on top of the oven and turn my head to the right. Tasha: Actually, we could roast some chicken too. I lower my head and search for the microwave's power cord, then fiddle with the microwave to find the cable jack and cables. Brilliant. Lucia: Let's leave the piping bag for later. Lucia: Otherwise, it might spill everywhere. Tasha picks up the microwave cord; I take the microwave's power cord and tinker with the oven. Tasha: These are all ingredients. I plug the cable into the wiring panel and tap the plug. Tasha: Just put them together. Tasha: Put the powders together. Tasha: Keep the ingredients together.

[DAY1 13:39:30 - DAY1 13:39:59]
I hold the oven. "I'll take care of this," I say. I pick up the microwave and fiddle with it, turning my head side to side as I watch Tasha. Lucia asks, "Should we remove this bag?" Tasha says, "Yeah, all the bags need to be removed." I hold the microwave while watching Tasha fidget. "Let's go, let's do this," I say. Tasha says, "Uh, let me pull this thread first." "Alright," I say. "Wash the thread," I say. I continue holding the microwave and turn my head to follow Tasha as she fiddles. Lucia says, "At this point..." Lucia says, "I'll just tie it up." Lucia adds, "Otherwise, it keeps dragging on the floor."
